requirements.requirement: Under an actual out-of-memory event, the kernel kills the memory-hog (not inventory-api), and inventory-api keeps serving throughout and after the event
requirements.summary: The memory-hog was launched and confirmed unprotected (oom_score_adj=0), but immediately afterward node1 became totally unreachable via the exec/SSH channel ('exec request failed on channel 0', later 'Connection reset by peer'). No dmesg/oom log, no post-event /health check, no confirmation that inventory-api's process survived, and no confirmation the hog was actually reaped were captured over ~36 minutes of retries and into the final lifecycle snapshot. The required behavioral transition (baseline -> disruption -> recovery) could not be observed, so the central task outcome cannot be confirmed or refuted from the evidence.
